spend.basis: analytics.build_report; category families ICT services and labour hire/recruitment; values not payments

expiry.basis: Current analytical tagged contracts; recorded end dates, retender unconfirmed

buyict_gap.definition: Relevant BuyICT spend without recorded invitation
buyict_gap.basis: buyict.build_buyict relevant 36-month awards; exact buyer key or unique normalised label matching; absence is no recorded invitation, never proof of never invited

ipp_gap.basis: levers.build_levers portfolio results; agency mapping requires reviewed identity; historical portfolio signal

levers.basis: levers.build_levers; sum of 36-month exemption and 12-month band counts; not eligibility

forward.basis: forward.build_forward published_plan; dates must place window within next year

open_opportunities.definition: Open notices in retained Tender Feed snapshot
open_opportunities.basis: forward.build_forward open notices; current status requires recheck

rap.basis: research.build_rap; exact unique organisation name, proposal basis

lookalike.basis: relationships past_client and outcomes won; type, size, portfolio and category-spend vector; missing dimensions not rescaled

panel_access.definition: Linked panel spend where not a member
panel_access.basis: Known panel links plus panel_watchlist illoura_status; unknown memberships stay null

demand_vs_bench.basis: inputs.build_bench is regional and role aggregate; account attribution unavailable

procurement_target.basis: Exact-document approved RAP extraction has_procurement_target; absent finding unknown

employment_target.basis: Exact-document approved RAP extraction employment_target; absent finding unknown

supplier_value.definition: Government original awards in our categories

ipp_prime.basis: levers.build_levers; obligation signal, contract-specific MMR unverified

historical_value.basis: research.build_state; WA FY2021-24 only, source observations may repeat, not current spend

historical_frequency.basis: research.build_state; WA FY2021-24 only, not unique current awards

staffing_need.basis: Latest retained aged-care quarter as of date; 5 minus staffing stars, research signal not hiring intent

quality.basis: Latest retained aged-care quarter as of date; 5 minus overall stars

size.basis: Small=1 medium=2 large=3; no size inferred from missing data

source_notes: Internal research only; configuration is an analyst policy, not calibrated win probability.
Each positive component uses within-lane midrank percentiles; zero observations receive zero points. Missing weights are retained. Coverage excludes penalty inputs, which are reported separately.
No grants, budget or insourcing source exists; all remain unknown. Cross-lane overall rank is a research ordering with different lane evidence bases.
Large government supplier proxy: at least AUD 1 million in original tagged awards over 36 months; not company turnover. All safely named MMR primes are included regardless of this threshold.
